rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for an unverified statement or assertion.

example.english: This claim has not been verified yet.
example.traditional: 呢個講法仲未有人證實。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 zung6 mei6 jau5 jan4 zing3 sat6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for stating something as true without proving it.

example.english: I claim this news is true.
example.traditional: 我聲稱呢個消息係真嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing1 cing1 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.note: Use this when claiming a specific item, property, or entitlement as yours.

example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 wai4 caan2 ngo5 jing6 ling5 zo2

rows.meaning: right or basis for a claim
rows.note: Use this when a claim means an entitlement or right to demand something.

example.english: Members have a claim to a refund.
example.jyutping: wui5 jyun4 jau5 kyun4 lei6 jiu1 kau4 teoi3 fun2

rows.meaning: right or basis for a claim
rows.note: Use this when the claim means the grounds or basis supporting a demand.

example.jyutping: nei5 go3 sok3 soeng4 jau5 mou5 lei5 geoi3

rows.note: Use this construction when an attack, disaster, or event causes people to die.

example.english: That attack went on to claim three lives.
example.traditional: 嗰次襲擊令三個人死亡。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 zaap6 gik1 ling6 saam1 go3 jan4 sei2 mong4

rows.note: Use this for winning a prize or money in a sport or competition.

example.english: Our team finally managed to claim one hundred thousand dollars in prize money.
example.traditional: 我哋隊終於贏到十萬蚊獎金。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 zung1 jyu1 jeng4 dou3 sap6 maan6 man1 zoeng2 gam1

rows.note: Use this formal legal phrase for a demand asserting ownership of something.

example.english: They filed a claim of ownership with the court.
example.traditional: 佢哋向法院提出所有權申索。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hoeng3 faat3 jyun2 tai4 ceot1 so2 jau5 kyun4 san1 sok3
